reason: I make about $8,000 a year, so $29 a month is real money for a tool nobody I know uses. Free moving of my data is nice, but one to five paying companies and no references is too risky for me.
objection: Too many plans and I cannot tell which one I need. They are also brand new, and I do not want to pay and then lose my clients if they disappear.
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper single plan around $12-15, plus an owner of a shop like mine in my city who I can call and who says it works.
